transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Keep it gentle at first. Avoid heavy work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. I also wanted to ask, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, including for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A little more sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust. If it’s mild, sunglasses outside can help.

But if the bright light causes severe pain, or your eye is red and painful, that is not normal and we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for the information. I have one more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It is common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly over time. If it is still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for today. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you again!

verdict.label: pass
